issue.title: voice.transcribe fallback can leak secret-like exception text
issue.actual_behavior: When voice.transcribe falls back in deterministic mode (or provider-to-local fallback mode), exception text can be returned in fallback_reason and deterministic transcript without redaction.
issue.expected_behavior: Fallback reasons should be bounded and redacted before inclusion in response payload fields or deterministic transcript text.
repro_steps: Set VOICE_TRANSCRIBE_PROVIDER=openai with a seeded fake OPENAI_API_KEY in builder env.
Call voice.transcribe with fallback_mode=deterministic and patch provider call to raise an exception that embeds secret-like text and filesystem path.
Observe fallback_reason/transcript output before patch includes raw secret/path fragments.

evidence.before_after_proof: Before: fallback error text could include raw secret/path fragments. After: fallback reasons are run through safe redaction and payloads contain [redacted] markers instead of raw values.

proposed_fix.approach: Introduce a safe fallback reason helper and apply it to deterministic and provider-to-local fallback branches before constructing response payloads.

review_claim.duplicate_notes: Checked active comments/reviews/threads on vibeforge1111/spark-voice-comms#19 via GitHub connector in this run; no duplicate report for this transcribe fallback redaction issue was found.
review_claim.risk_notes: Change is localized to fallback-reason redaction; no provider logic, routing logic, or transcript parsing semantics were widened.
